thread:
alex.w: starting quarterly recert run. quick heads-up: our heuristic flagged ~72 'stale-admin' entitlements across prod projects. sample attached.
maria_p: thanks — can you paste the query you ran?
alex.w: sure
```sql
SELECT principal, role, created_at, last_seen FROM iam_bindings
WHERE role LIKE '%admin%' AND last_seen < now() - interval '180 days';
```
results include a mix of service accounts + user accounts.
samr: any KMS grants in that set? last time we had cross-project KMS admins.
alex.w: yes ~9 bindings to `roles/cloudkms.admin` from svcacct@analytics-prod. exported CSV to s3://redwood-sec/reports/recert-4755551111.csv
jamie-security: pinging infra-oncall — we need audit logs for those KMS keys for the last 90 days as compliance evidence.
audit-bot: export job queued: job_id=recert-4755-01. ETA ~25m. logs will include key versions and grant change history.
infra-oncall: acked. will snapshot KMS IAM policies and attach to INF-8892 ticket.
maria_p: for remediation, propose: 1) annotate owner for each binding; 2) open batched PRs to remove stale grants with a 7-day rollback window; 3) allow temp-elevation flow for any svc that fails tests.
samr: +1. can we canary this on staging first? last run we had a metrics job break.
alex.w: did a canary on analytics-staging — removed 6 stale grants, no regressions after 48h. logs look clean.
jamie-security: compliance needs attestation links in the PRs: owner contact, why access is required, and verification artifacts. use template in /docs/compliance/attest-template.md
maria_p: i'll open batched change requests and assign owners today. tagging @oncall-weekend for awareness.
alex.w: remediation PR body snippet (for reference):
```diff
- roles/cloudkms.admin -> removed
+ roles/cloudkms.viewer -> added
+ owner: team/analytics
+ justification: "key rotation & decryption performed by analytics pipeline; limited viewer reduces blast radius"
+ evidence: s3://redwood-sec/reports/recert-4755551111.csv
```
jamie-security: pls capture audit export id in the PR description. i'll coordinate evidence collection and upload to the compliance bucket.
samr: timeline?
maria_p: owners notified, PRs targeted by EOD tomorrow. plan to merge Wed AM with a 2-hour rollback window, infra-oncall will run smoke checks.
alex.w: will add a short smoke checklist in PR description: healthcheck endpoints, job-run sanity, and alerts.
audit-bot: export complete: s3://redwood-sec/exports/recert-4755551111-logs.tar.gz (md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e)
alex.w: received and linked to INF-8892. saving copies to secure bucket.
infra-oncall: i'll run final smoke after merge and post results here. keep me in the PR.
maria_p: after merge i'll kick off evidence attestation and close the recert task. scheduling a 2-week follow-up to validate no hidden regressions.
samr: lgtm. thanks all :thumbsup:
jamie-security: thanks team — nice focused run. we'll convert any interesting fallout into a follow-up postmortem if needed.
